SECURITY_ISOLATION.mission: Independently verify authentication, isolation, privacy and fail-closed runtime boundaries.

CONTRACT_COMPATIBILITY.mission: Independently verify compatibility with admitted baselines and shared contracts.

HUMAN_FACTORS.mission: Prepare or evaluate representative human journeys under the current human-centred contract.

AUTHORITY_AUDIT.mission: Independently verify that product/runtime/read-model behavior does not create unauthorized domain or canonical authority.

QA_ASSURANCE.mission: Independently verify deterministic behavior, regressions, evidence completeness and release readiness.

handoff_rule: Agents return bounded result/evidence packages. The orchestrator resolves declared dependencies and promotion gates; it does not infer professional authority.
